Explore published measurements with the same workspaces used during acquisition.
Each showcase connects the physical setup, recorded settings, reference figures,
and downloadable inputs to an offline walkthrough.

## Available showcases

| Measurement | What to explore | Walkthrough | Dataset |
|---|---|---|---|
| Na-22 511 keV coincidences with two LBC scintillators | Photopeak selection, CFD timing, coincidence energy matrices, and two source/detector arrangements | [Na-22 Coincidence Walkthrough](showcase_na22_coincidence) | [Zenodo record 23667120](https://zenodo.org/records/23667120) |

## Start without hardware

1. Download a session archive from the showcase's Zenodo record and extract it.
2. Install the application and its required native libiio runtime using
   [Getting Started](getting_started).
3. Select the documented channel count and **Offline / Replay Mode** at startup.
4. Choose **File -> Replay Session...** and open the extracted `.nlab-session`
   directory.
5. Follow the showcase's measurement-specific steps and interpretation notes.

Session replay reconstructs analysis from recorded inputs. It follows the
recorded timeline, so wait for the completion status before comparing final
plots. The final recorded views remain visible after playback finishes.

The experiment photographs and measurement plots on these pages come from the
identified dataset. Captions distinguish the recorded acquisition views from
the offline workflow. See [Use Cases](use_cases) for other workflows and
[Capture Files and Integrity](data_formats) for session validation.
